requirements.title: A character expression format shall have a valid format specification as its leading part
requirements.definition: A character expression used as a format shall evaluate to a character string whose leading part is a valid format specification.

requirements.title: Positions through the final right parenthesis are defined and stable; trailing positions are irrelevant
requirements.definition: Characters through the final right parenthesis shall be defined at execution and shall not become redefined or undefined during the statement; following positions need not be defined and may contain any data with no effect.

pending.stable-through-execution: Control fixture: character(len=4) fmt='(I3)' is not modified during internal WRITE(buf,fmt) 7, and character(len=3) buf must be exactly '  7'. Negative fixture is source-control only until a safe same-statement mutation mechanism is registered: it must change only one character position in fmt during execution of that WRITE, with the repaired program restoring the unmodified fmt; no oracle may rely on unspecified expression evaluation order.

requirements.title: A character array element format specification shall be entirely within that element
requirements.definition: If a character array element is used as the format, the complete format specification shall be within that element.
